mission.title: Install and Configure Charmed Kubernetes
mission.description: Charmed Kubernetes is a distribution of Kubernetes that is designed for easy deployment and management using Juju. It is ideal for users looking for a robust Kubernetes solution that integrates well with Ubuntu and offers extensive support for various cloud environments. Key trade-offs include the need for Juju for deployment and management, which may add complexity for users unfamiliar with it.

steps.title: Install Juju
steps.description:
Juju is required to deploy Charmed Kubernetes. This step installs the Juju client on your machine.

```bash

sudo snap install juju --classic

```

> Installs the latest stable version of Juju.

steps.title: Bootstrap the Juju controller
steps.description:
This command initializes the Juju controller, which is necessary for managing your Kubernetes deployment.

```bash

juju bootstrap <cloud-provider> <controller-name> --config bootstrap-series=focal

```

> Replace <cloud-provider> with your cloud (e.g., aws, gcp) and <controller-name> with a name for your controller.

steps.title: Deploy Charmed Kubernetes
steps.description:
This command deploys the Charmed Kubernetes bundle, which includes the necessary components for a Kubernetes cluster.

```bash

juju deploy charmed-kubernetes --channel 1.31/stable

```

> Use the desired channel for the Kubernetes version.

steps.title: Verify the deployment
steps.description:
This command checks the status of the deployed services to ensure everything is running correctly.

```bash

juju status

```

> Look for all services to be in the 'active' state.

steps.title: Configure Kubernetes access
steps.description:
This step sets up your kubeconfig file to allow kubectl to interact with your new Kubernetes cluster.

```bash

juju config kubernetes-control-plane kubeconfig

```

> This will output the kubeconfig which you can save to ~/.kube/config.

uninstall.title: Remove Charmed Kubernetes
uninstall.description:
This command will remove the Charmed Kubernetes deployment and all associated resources. Be aware that this will result in data loss.

```bash

juju destroy-controller <controller-name> --destroy-all-models

```

> Replace <controller-name> with your controller name.

uninstall.title: Cleanup orphaned resources
uninstall.description:
This step ensures that any orphaned resources such as load balancers or PVCs are removed.

```bash

juju remove-application charmed-kubernetes

```

> This will remove the application from Juju.

upgrade.title: Upgrade Charmed Kubernetes
upgrade.description:
Before upgrading, ensure you have a backup of your configurations and data. This step will upgrade your Charmed Kubernetes deployment.

```bash

juju upgrade-charm charmed-kubernetes --channel 1.31/stable

juju status

```

> This command upgrades to the specified channel.
> Verify that all services are running after the upgrade.

troubleshooting.title: Error: 'juju bootstrap failed'
troubleshooting.description:
**Cause:** This may occur if the specified cloud provider is not configured correctly.

**Fix:**
Check your cloud credentials and ensure the provider is supported.

troubleshooting.title: Error: 'kubernetes-control-plane not ready'
troubleshooting.description:
**Cause:** The control plane may not have initialized properly.

**Fix:**
Run 'juju status' to check for errors and 'juju debug-log' for more details.

**Affected versions:** 1.29, 1.30, 1.31

troubleshooting.title: kubectl command fails with 'Unable to connect to the server'
troubleshooting.description:
**Cause:** This indicates that your kubeconfig is not set up correctly.

**Fix:**
Ensure your kubeconfig file is correctly configured and points to the right cluster.

**Affected versions:** 1.29, 1.30, 1.31

troubleshooting.title: Error: 'juju deploy failed'
troubleshooting.description:
**Cause:** This may happen if there are insufficient resources available in the cloud.

**Fix:**
Check your cloud provider's resource limits and ensure you have enough capacity.

versionNotes.changes: Added support for Kubernetes 1.31 features, improved charm integration.
versionNotes.migrationSteps: No specific migration steps are required for this version.

resolution.summary: You should see the output of 'juju status' showing all services in the 'active' state, indicating that your Charmed Kubernetes cluster is running successfully.

prerequisites.description: Ensure you have the necessary tools and cloud resources before starting the installation.
